lines.text: David son of Jesse, the one anointed by the God of Jacob, speaks his last words.
David says the prophet Nathan spoke through him and that God's word was on his tongue.
God says one who rules with justice in the fear of God is like morning light at a cloudless dawn.
David says God made an everlasting covenant with him and will bring about his full salvation and every desire.
The worthless are like thorns raked aside, and the man who touches them needs cloth or a spear shaft.
